criteria.detail: Constraints state 'Append-only branch. The branch tip only ever moves forward, by adding commits.'
Constraints list 'Forbidden git operations: git reset (any mode), git rebase, git commit --amend, and any history reordering.'
Redo path says a commit needing redo is left in place and reported with a proposed follow-up commit, never repaired in place.
no forbidden sources cited, no git command output

judge_reasoning: The actor's spec grounded in catalyst-v2-writing-delegation-specs satisfies all three criteria: append-only tip, explicit forbid list covering reset/rebase/amend/reordering, and a leave-in-place-plus-follow-up redo path.
